control_sensitivity_metric.aggregation: require every control x archive schedule x split cell; no pooling or weighting
control_sensitivity_metric.comparison_unit: canonical local daily relation-card payload for one decision day
control_sensitivity_metric.denominator: unique eligible decision days for one exact control,schedule,split cell
control_sensitivity_metric.numerator: eligible denominator days whose payload changed

relation_control_eligibility.availability_plus_seven_days: baseline or shifted card day contains at least one newly available event
relation_control_eligibility.dependency_edge_direction_reverse: card contains at least one ADDED or REMOVED dependency delta
relation_control_eligibility.old_new_direction_reverse: card contains at least one source event
relation_control_eligibility.proposal_version_pair_cyclic_permutation: card contains an UPDATE from a protocol/source_year stratum with at least two eligible UPDATE events
relation_control_eligibility.protocol_label_swap: decision day has at least one non-sentinel event or counterpart
relation_control_eligibility.section_label_cyclic_rotation: card contains at least one changed section other than OTHER
relation_control_eligibility.within_day_event_order_reverse: either protocol has at least two newly available events that day

relation_control_transforms.availability_plus_seven_days: add exactly seven calendar days to every available_at under each archive schedule and rebuild every card
relation_control_transforms.old_new_direction_reverse: swap all old/new derived fields and exact side paths; map CREATE<->DELETE and retain UPDATE; swap explicit metadata states; reverse D5 normalized text-delta ADD/REMOVE rows before canonical D6 rechunking; retain administrative quarantine as model-hidden
relation_control_transforms.proposal_version_pair_cyclic_permutation: within each protocol/source_year, sort eligible UPDATE events by event_id and rotate old-blob-derived fields forward by one while holding new-blob-derived fields fixed
relation_control_transforms.protocol_label_swap: swap ethereum<->bitcoin labels after extraction; preserve raw event identity, exact side-path audit hash, metadata state, and underlying D5 normalized text-delta rows; rebuild canonical D6 chunks and relation cards; administrative quarantine remains model-hidden
relation_control_transforms.section_label_cyclic_rotation: rotate changed-section labels over ABSTRACT,MOTIVATION,SPECIFICATION,RATIONALE,BACKWARD_COMPATIBILITY,SECURITY,TESTS,IMPLEMENTATION,COPYRIGHT; keep OTHER fixed
relation_control_transforms.within_day_event_order_reverse: reverse each protocol/day canonical event sequence before pairing; preserve event payloads
